description: Reproducible diagnostic report built from the event log.

evidence.description: Evidence rows with AI-extraction labelling (extractor starting spark/muse- means AI-extracted).

expected_vs_measured.description: One row per performed test, verbatim from its test_result event. Engine-sound rows carry DSP numbers and origin signal_processing (signal processing, not AI).

origin.description: signal_processing = stdlib DSP (engine sound); direct_observation = human/visual check; deterministic = physics/rule/Mode 06 evaluator.

fallback_used.description: True when any llm_call record in the session came from the Spark Open fallback (provider baseten with a fallback marker).

reproducibility.description: Pins everything needed to rebuild this report bit-identically.

sam_overlays.description: SAM overlay references attached to image evidence.

second_opinions.description: Vision second-opinion views (agreement/sources per keyframe). Display-only; posteriors never depend on them.

stop_triggers.description: Stop-and-see-a-pro triggers that fired, if any.

vin_last6.description: Last 6 of the VIN for display; the only VIN substring a report may carry.

wonder_review.description: Validated Wonder review, or null when the review call was unavailable (budget/API). Null never blocks the report.

wonder_unavailable.description: Human-readable reason when wonder_review is null.
